channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Oct 26
item.description:
59 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Scientist boats now skip invalid targets and will turn around to face a visible player if none of the crew can see the current target.
  • Cows can satisfy their light requirement using lamps, allowing indoor lighting to keep them happy.
  • Fixed an infinite‑power console variable that broke static CCTV cameras, restoring camera functionality.
  • Item pool size increased from 512 to 2,048 slots, reducing overflow issues and allowing more items to exist simultaneously.

NPCs & Creatures

  • Scientist boats now skip invalid targets and will turn around to face a visible player if none of the crew can see the current target.
  • Cows can satisfy their light requirement using lamps, allowing indoor lighting to keep them happy.

World Building & Structures

  • Animal fences and gates can now be placed more easily on sloped terrain, simplifying fence deployment.
  • Fixed an infinite‑power console variable that broke static CCTV cameras, restoring camera functionality.
  • Multiple sprinkler bugs fixed: splash effects now trigger reliably, fuel type null‑spikes are removed, radwater tint flicker is gone, sprinklers start with proper water, and view‑model water guns/pistols now produce correct green radwater splash effects.

Inventory & Loot

  • Item pool size increased from 512 to 2,048 slots, reducing overflow issues and allowing more items to exist simultaneously.
  • Adjusted random gutting bonuses for Catfish, Orange Roughy, Salmon, and Small Shark: a 20% chance now yields a blueprint fragment instead of cloth, and added blueprint fragments and pages to underwater crate loot pools.

Map & Death

  • Bags assigned to a dead player now appear on the map immediately, preventing them from being hidden after death or server rejoin.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Ramps now correctly grant line‑of‑sight, removing the blue LOS blockage when standing on or near them.
  • Death‑screen sleeping‑bag buttons no longer overlap or resize incorrectly, preventing misclicks when respawning.
  • Dark square glitch that appeared during dungeon spawns has been removed, clearing the view for players entering dungeons.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 25
item.description:
16 development commits

Animals & AI

  • Animal repellant buff now only affects sharks (they flee) and bee swarms (they won't chase); bulls and rams ignore the buff and will neither flee nor charge.
  • Chickens on the tutorial island no longer act aggressively.

Farming

  • Sunflower seed-stage plants can now be cleared reliably with a melee weapon.
  • Child livestock can leave their mother's leash radius to eat from a trough, preventing them from getting stuck hungry in pens.

Building & UI

  • Building planner now shows the specific blocker name instead of a generic "Cannot build in this area" message.
  • Ramp placement improved: aiming at the center of a foundation now places ramps correctly.

Bug Fixes

  • Wrapping paper can no longer be filled with water, preventing unintended item behavior.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Oct 24
item.description:
10 development commits

Tools & Crafting

  • Shears now harvest 25% more wool, have double durability (200), and deal reduced damage (4 slash + 4 stab), making them a more efficient wool‑gathering tool.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Network packet batching reduces latency and improves responsiveness; can be toggled at runtime.
  • Fixed viewmodel camera bone positioning, correcting misaligned weapon view.
